question: Can a token-free partially observable online causal-map policy use real action consequences to achieve more official MiniGrid goal rewards in unseen layouts/families than independently trained conventional policies and a strong non-learning goal-aware explorer, with cold retention after interference?
hypothesis: After observing identical official MiniGrid behavior trajectories, an online episodic causal-map navigator will achieve at least 0.15 higher mean official goal-completion rate than every preregistered trained and nonlearning control in BOTH new Empty-8x8 layouts and DynamicObstacles-6x6 environments, without failure of cold retained performance, while recording actual paid decisions and strictly isolating holdout rewards.

predecessor_evidence.note: Prior MG19 action-consequence forecasting on genuine MiniGrid failed against zero-learning persistence; MG20 explicitly changes target to official reward and actual chosen actions. MG19 original seed identities and source remain untouched.

inputs.name: Farama MiniGrid simulator
inputs.integrity: Exact installed wheel provenance and package metadata captured before registered use via Python pip freeze and SHA-256 in Actions; no unverified package hash asserted here.

inputs.name: Frozen source-family/episode/action manifest
inputs.source: Canonical sorted-key compact JSON with exact manifest identity values; identical 300-episode/5-arm budget and source names precommitted.

seed_ranges.train: 730001–730024 inclusive on each of two train envs (48 distinct episodes)
seed_ranges.cold: 750001–750012 inclusive evaluated before and after interference per policy (24x5)

frozen_design.budget: 48 training + 12 interference common physical trajectories + (12 cold-before + 12 cold-after + 12 unseen-size + 12 unseen-family) * 5 policy arms = 300 independent episodes, <=38,400 physically charged env.step calls, fewer on terminal; no per-arm replayed training simulator steps.
frozen_design.action_interface: Action indices 0=left,1=right,2=forward,3=pickup,5=toggle read from published MiniGrid action interface; every arm receives only actual official partial 7x7x3 local image, direction, last action and reward/termination after its action. Never inspect hidden agent position, grid map, env.unwrapped, oracle planner, agent path, mission text or evaluator goal state. No future observation available when deciding.
frozen_design.candidate: Non-transformer, non-token coordinate-aligned online topological memory using public egocentric pixel grid, public direction and action-consequence-derived dead-reckoning; fixed bounded 256-cell working map per episode, learned cross-episode passability counts for public object categories (only training updates), shortest known-path to visually observed goal, frontier exploration for unseen areas. Absolutely no hidden world coords or goal locations. Reset ephemeral map per episode.

controls.detail: Exactly the same capacity, online observation and implementation, but spatial evidence deliberately scattered deterministically during storage; cross-episode passability updates preserved.
Strong non-learning goal-visible greedy exploration using current partial image and deterministic seeded wall avoidance, no map.

Fully trained off-policy tabular Q learner with frozen feature abstraction from current image, direction, front cell and visible goal, all observed shared training rewards, gamma 0.95, learning rate 0.2; retains online learned Q values; uses reactive fallback when Q tied.

Fully trainable 12-hidden-unit recurrent policy imitating the same fixed behavior traces (only observed actions and official reward-weighted sequences), input/hidden/recurrent/output/bias weights updated by deterministic BPTT, 8-step observation-action history.

frozen_design.training: One fixed observation-only goal-seeking exploratory behavior policy generates identical 48 physical training and 12 interference episodes for every arm. Tabular Q learns from actual transitions and official reward, recurrent policy uses same behavior action targets/reward-weighting, map policy learns spatial and passability from public transitions. No arm gets separate extra training interactions. Positive reward is official env reward>0, no shaped or hidden reward.
frozen_design.evaluation: Each trained/frozen arm independently takes actual actions from the same held-out seed/environment initial states. Official goal success = reward>0 on at least one actual charged env.step before 128. Report mean goal success, discounted official return, median steps-to-success, per-seed goal wins against strongest comparator, cold pre/post success difference, all source/action/outcome hashes, live map size, CPU and checkpoint bytes; no reward shaping or simulator backdoor.
frozen_design.cold_and_interference: Snapshot each training model before 12 shared DoorKey interference episodes, score cold seeds before; train interference on same physical trace once, score cold again on same seeds; candidate learned per-episode map reset but retained passability knowledge must still exist; all models use same runtime and action limits.
frozen_design.qualification: Python 3.12 available on both Ubuntu and Windows with minigrid==3.2.0, gymnasium==1.4.0, numpy==2.3.4. Deterministic seeded RNG, quantize recurrent weights to 8 decimals each update. Strict cross-OS exact charged episode action/outcome trace SHA, action counts, success flags, model checkpoint SHA and any numeric score discrepancies <=1e-8. Record exact package versions, pip freeze, source SHA/tree; max 64KiB serialized stored model per arm.
frozen_design.coverage: Require >=8 official-success events among 48 fixed behavior training episodes. Require >=3 official goal successes total ACROSS all policy arms on EACH of the two transfer families; otherwise classification INVALID_TASK_COVERAGE (independent of science performance). 128-step cap and event count externally verified.
frozen_design.first_use: Commit prereg alone as ancestor of code. Before draft PR opens, test only non-registered seeds (11,17,19) and source/environment identities. Exactly one registered physical study per OS on PR opened event. All successor documentation/atlas synchronizations skip original first-use; no post-result tuning.

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_ONLY only if valid actual physical custody and positive-task coverage, candidate >=0.15 higher goal-success fraction than the best among all four controls in BOTH unfamiliar environments (at least 2 additional successes out of 12 per split), candidate strictly wins on >=5/12 seeds in each transfer against strongest control, candidate cold-after official success >=cold-before success -1/12, candidate at least as effective as reactive on cold-after, independent cross-OS exact trace and model checkpoint SHA parity, no eval training, all stored checkpoints <=65536 bytes and candidate total decision CPU <=3x trained recurrent inference. Even on PASS remains only development evidence; not native AGI or loop acceptance.
classification_rules.mixed: MIXED_DEV iff valid actual reward/physical/portability coverage but primary fails and candidate has a nontrivial positive result (>=2 more official successes than at least one comparator on one transfer family, or <=1/12 cold success loss after interference together with nonzero goal completion).
classification_rules.negative: NEGATIVE_DEV iff valid reward/physical/portability coverage and primary false without registered partial signal.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE, INVALID_REPRO or INVALID_TASK_COVERAGE if wrong prereg ancestry, source/package/seed drift, fewer than 8 behavior training successes, fewer than 3 transfer successes all arms in either family, missing real physical env.step receipts, hidden state/mission leakage, extra non-budget env calls, uncharged controls, failure to train recurrent/tabular, accidental eval training, missing or incorrect cold snapshot, cross-OS action/goal/checkpoint mismatch, over-capacity checkpoints. Performance failure is NEVER infrastructure failure unless an independent evidence defect is established.

prohibited_after_primary_run: changing seeds, training, controls, task identifiers, thresholds or actions after original outcome
replaying original heldout evaluation with tuned source
promoting synthetic result to native intelligence
modifying official accepted refs, autonomy loop or workstation
note: Separate external research lane; no deployment, controller, model promotion or official policy change; preserve invalid/negative results exactly.
